findings.text: non-blocking: the retirement is unguarded — deleting the rebuild test adds no assertion, so no test reddens if a future change restores a rebuild that reads a path outside the repository or reintroduces the out-of-repository DEFAULT_* defaults the done_when forbids.

non-blocking: _labels, _cached_conventions, _name_axis, _docs_axis, _logistic, _fit_name_logistic, _clamp, GOLDEN_NAME and GOLDEN_DOCS are retained with no caller in the module at head; only three evidence scripts under docs/evidence reference them, and those scripts still import the removed DEFAULT_NAME_RECEIPTS/DEFAULT_DOCS_RECEIPTS, so the retention is partial.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read the manifest; it records the four commits, a baseline of 10 passed/1 skipped, an after run of 75 passed/0 skipped with EXIT=0, byte-identical threshold SHA256 a0aa1e74, and an empty negative_control_log explained by the retirement ruling.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The four changed paths (imas_codex/standard_names/review/cascade_calibration.py, tests/standard_names/test_cascade_calibration.py, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-cascade-receipts.html and its -run.py) all fall inside the seven declared write paths at prompt.txt:96-103.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion to tests/standard_names/test_cascade_calibration.py:1, so nothing fails if an out-of-repository DEFAULT_* path or a rebuild function is reintroduced; the surviving tests predate the change.
justifications.evidence: retirement-head.log proves 75 passed with no skips, but no gate asserts that imas_codex/standard_names/review/cascade_calibration.py no longer defaults outside the repository, which prompt.txt:127 names as part of the measure.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/standard_names/review/cascade_calibration.py:1 keeps the surrounding module idiom, but the retained axis builders at line 41 have no caller in the module at head.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/standard_names/test_cascade_calibration.py:104 loses the rebuild test the goal names, and the replacement is the retirement the lead ruling at docs/plans/sn-pipeline-hygiene.html authorises rather than the stated deliverable.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/standard_names/review/cascade_calibration.py:307 keeps matched_cutoff and delegates intervals to imas_codex/discovery/base/evaluation.bootstrap_interval rather than adding a second implementation.
